meta.name: add-clidash
meta.description: Add clidash — a zero-dependency, read-only web dashboard that derives its tabs and tables at runtime from any CLI that lists resources as JSON. Ships pre-wired for NanoClaw's ncl CLI (agent groups, sessions, channels, users, roles), plus message-activity charts, a log tail, and a read-only file viewer for group skills/CLAUDE.md/profiles.

copy.tagline: 将任意 JSON 输出 CLI 转为实时 Web 仪表盘
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有输出 JSON 的 CLI 工具，想快速生成 Web 仪表盘
copy.tagline_en: Turn any JSON-output CLI into a live web dashboard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a CLI that outputs JSON and want a quick web dashboard

howto.what: 装上此技能后,Claude 能按步骤安装并配置只读网页仪表盘 clidash,从 CLI 的 JSON 输出生成标签页和表格,并提供 NanoClaw 的代理、活动、日志和文件查看面板。访问地址为 http://127.0.0.1:4690。
howto.when: 当用户要求添加或配置 clidash,或需要查看 NanoClaw 资源仪表盘时触发。

say.note: Claude 会复制 clidash 目录并创建配置文件。

say.text: 启动 clidash 并打开仪表盘
给 clidash 增加一个 docker 标签页

howto.what_en: Claude installs clidash, a zero-dependency read-only web dashboard that dynamically builds tabs/tables from CLI JSON output. It includes NanoClaw panels for agents, activity, logs, and files, served at http://127.0.0.1:4690.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to install or configure clidash, or requests a dashboard for NanoClaw resources (agents, sessions, etc.).

say_en.text: Set up clidash in my project.
say_en.note: Claude copies the clidash directory and creates the config file.

say_en.text: Start clidash and open the dashboard.
say_en.note: Claude runs the server and shows the local URL.

say_en.text: Add a docker tab to clidash.
say_en.note: Claude updates the config to include Docker resources.
